title: Socket.IO acknowledgement for 'device_event' (cloud -> gateway)
description: accepted:true is sent only AFTER the cloud transaction committed (durable acceptance). The gateway may delete/archive its outbox row only on accepted:true with a matching event_id. accepted:false + retryable:true means keep the event and retry; retryable:false means stop retrying and keep the row as rejected.

alert_id.description: null when the event was recorded but quarantined

quarantined.description: true when no current owner may see this event (device unclaimed, or event observed before the current ownership period)
